g.text: What Cilium needs to run on Talos.
spec.cni.cilium.values on the TalosCluster. Only ichor-admin
can write it. One function checks it before every Cilium Job.
Applied last, so they always win. Setting one is refused: the
settings Talos requires, the KubePrism address (only when kube-proxy is replaced),
kubeProxyReplacement, tunnelProtocol and the five *.secretsNamespace.name keys.
The values of the Helm release cilium
